body.name: Indicator-coarsened margins
body.construction: For \(j\in\mathcal J\), set \(A_j=\{Y_j=s_j^\star\}\), \(p_i=\sum_{s\in\mathcal Y}o_{is}\), \(a_j=e_{j,s_j^\star}\), \(b_j=o_{j,s_j^\star}\), \(c_j=a_j-b_j\), \(d_j=p_j-b_j\), \(h_j=1-p_j-c_j\), \(p_0=1-\sum_{j\in\mathcal J}p_j\), \(g=p_0+\sum_{j\in\mathcal J}b_j\), and \(H=\sum_{j\in\mathcal J}h_j\).
